problems.text: Each stamp runs every default test, whatever the change touched, so a ticket waits about 17 minutes per stamp.

goals.text: A stamp runs the tests a change can reach and no fewer.

outcomes.change: The tests gate runs a selection from a coverage map
outcomes.checked_by: tests ported from the original's `test_select_tests.py` (selection by changed lines, test files, unknown tests, fallbacks), and a stamp after a one-function change runs fewer tests than the full suite

outcomes.change: A change the map cannot answer runs everything
outcomes.checked_by: tests that a change under `apm/`, `tests/fixtures/`, a conftest file, `pyproject.toml` or `uv.lock` records a full run
